text: From 500 transcripts to themes with real quotes · every number links to the words behind it
originalText: From 500 transcripts to themes with real quotes · every number links to the words behind it

text:
Key decisions
- Code one answer at a time with a
  typed schema: code, quote span, sentiment
- Verify every quote is a real substring
  of the transcript: no invented quotes
- Cluster codes into themes across
  interviews; stable theme ids
- Counts with ranges, not fake precision
- The researcher edits the codebook;
  re-run is cheap and deterministic
